name: Vijayawada
registryBasis: The official NTR District portal, whose headquarters is Vijayawada, directs residents to Andhra Pradesh land records; the Government of Andhra Pradesh Survey, Settlements and Land Records Department publishes BhuNaksha AP as cadastral mapping software. This verifies relevant local/state registry services but not parcel coverage at the WUP locator.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official AP BhuNaksha HTTPS viewer path timed out on direct anonymous requests (Node and curl); HTTP also timed out. The official APSAC Cadastral Maps dashboard and public ArcGIS web-map metadata are reachable, but its AP cadastral map config contains only one cached tiled MapService layer plus administrative boundaries, no feature/vector layer. Its MapServer metadata path returns HTTP 403. No full georeferenced parcel polygon route was verified at the WUP locator.
scopeLimits: The official NTR District portal confirms Vijayawada as district headquarters and links land records. Direct BhuNaksha viewer requests timed out, so its static JavaScript/schema and selector workflow could not be inspected. The official APSAC dashboard and cadastral-map page were directly fetched; its public map item is titled AP Cadastral Map, but the map config exposes only an ArcGISTiledMapServiceLayer named `cadastral_ap_cache` and four administrative layers. Direct metadata for that map service returned 403. A cached tile map is not full parcel feature geometry, and no vector geometry sample was returned or retained.
remainingUncertainty: The AP BhuNaksha host could not be reached by the direct client, and the APSAC raster cache’s service metadata is restricted. Whether a separate anonymous AP feature service covers urban Vijayawada remains unverified; the published public map item does not expose feature layers.

officialSources.observation: Official NTR District portal states that district headquarters is Vijayawada and provides the district-level administrative context.
Official NTR District land-records page directs users to the Andhra Pradesh land-records portal and identifies a Mee-Seva center in Vijayawada.

Government of Andhra Pradesh Survey, Settlements and Land Records portal identifies BhuNaksha as cadastral mapping software and describes geo-referenced spatial data. This does not establish an anonymous geometry endpoint or coverage at the target point.
Andhra Pradesh Space Applications Centre portal lists a state GIS and cadastral maps service; no Vijayawada parcel geometry response was obtained.
Direct GET returned HTTP 200 and embeds a public ArcGIS Web AppBuilder map with app item ID `7e3b53a1a265421483fbcbb26c275834`.
Direct public JSON app configuration points to webmap item `b54a4a9a00b441a2bdd8f993d140edd5` and configures a default extent separate from the WUP locator.

Direct public webmap configuration has five layers: one ArcGISTiledMapServiceLayer `cadastral_ap_cache`, and four administrative boundary/label map layers; it has no feature collection or feature service layer.
Direct anonymous metadata request returned HTTP 403 from nginx; no feature geometry was requested.
